# Concern 4 — family-clustered CIs for closed-loop FCT contrasts (generated by c4_clustered.py)

Contrast = FCT(strategy) − FCT(reference), shown in % of the reference (positive = strategy slower). Cell CI: 30 (family, seed) cells resampled. Clustered CI: 6 families resampled, then 5 seeds within each drawn family. Both 95%, 2,000 draws, seed 42, same cells for both strategies in each draw. Verdict on the tick CI: + entire CI > 0, − entire CI < 0, 0 includes 0 (vs guarded score, + = guard advantage detected). `*` = the % CI gives a different verdict than the tick CI.
